description: Defines the PartialEmployeeAttachment class representing an employee's attachment with properties like ID, description, filename, size, type, and metadata about who attached it and when.

classes.name: PartialEmployeeAttachment
classes.description: Data Transfer Object (DTO) for employee attachment details, including metadata about attachment time and user.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the attachment object with provided details and sets attached date and time.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the attachment.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getAttachedBy
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: getAttachedByName
methods.description: Returns the name of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: getAttachedTime
methods.description: Returns the time when the attachment was made.

methods.name: getAttachedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the attachment was made.

methods.name: setAttachedTime
methods.description: Sets the attached time formatted as a string from a DateTime object.

methods.name: setAttachedDate
methods.description: Sets the attached date formatted as a string from a DateTime object.
